::: {.callout-note}
I am on research leave during the 2025/26 school year, and will be based in New York City during that time. I am not available for in-person meetings, and may take longer than usual to reply to e-mails. 
:::

On the University of Chicago campus, I am located in [Ryerson](https://maps.uchicago.edu/location/ryerson-laboratory/) 162-B. Although I am usually in my office during regular business hours, the best way to contact me is through e-mail: [borja@uchicago.edu](mailto:borja@uchicago.edu). If you want to drop by my office, please let me know in advance to make sure that I am available that date/time.

🇪🇸 *Estudiantes hispanoparlantes* 🇪🇸  Si preferís comunicaros conmigo en español, por favor no dudeis en hacerlo. Aunque utilizo el inglés por defecto aqui en la Universidad de Chicago, mi lengua materna es el español.
